questions.question: Which of the following is a common English word for 'formes'?
'The English word for 'formes' is 'shapes'' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a common English preposition used to indicate location?
'The preposition 'in' is used to indicate location inside something' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a common English preposition used to indicate location on a surface?
'The preposition 'at' is used to indicate location at a specific point' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a common English preposition used to indicate location in relation to something else?
'The preposition 'next to' is used to indicate location in relation to something else' is a true statement.
